title: Body-phase machines
statement: Given three finite Turing machines $M_V$, $M_I$, and $M_P$ over the Boolean alphabet, associate a multi-tape Turing machine to each body-machine phase, with $3+2k_V+2k_I+2k_P$ work tapes and the corresponding phase-indexed body states. The test phase uses the test-machine host, the clear phase clears the word on the second work tape, and the increment phase increments the word on the first work tape.
hypotheses_covered: three finite Turing machines over the Boolean alphabet
